content: Meera Chauhan discussed policy reinstatement with insurance agent Ravi Menon. The total due is ₹14,800, consisting of ₹12,300 for the premium and a ₹2,500 non-waivable reinstatement fee. Ravi agreed to split the payment into two installments of ₹7,400 each. Meera will pay the first installment and submit the signed reinstatement form today to reactivate the policy.

action_items: Meera to print, sign, and upload the reinstatement form
Meera to make the first installment payment of ₹7,400 within 5 business days
Ravi to update the system and send a confirmation email upon receiving the form and first payment
